courses.title: Online Business Startup Masterclass
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in online business startup masterclass for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on office, business management and professional workplace skills. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Strengthens office software, bookkeeping awareness and remote team collaboration skills. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Set up basic business planning documents
Use office tools for reports and presentations
Track simple income and expense records
Manage customer information responsibly
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Notebook or digital document for exercises and notes
Interest in organising business or remote work tasks
